source_truth_note: This sidecar is derived visual evidence for the referenced image. The repo image bytes and package manifest remain authoritative for custody; this sidecar does not authorize derivative images or broaden canon.

summary: Style Anti-Patterns Sheet v1.1 for Adventures of Patch, cataloguing six categories of visual drift to avoid across characters, props, and environments. The sheet lays out purpose, core rules, Patch canon, a pre-approval checklist, and a grid of red-marked anti-pattern examples, plus a 'WHEN IN DOUBT: DON'T' callout.

composition: Landscape reference sheet with a dark navy top banner, structured rule columns on the left and right, and a central six-panel anti-pattern grid.
Top banner reads 'ADVENTURES OF PATCH | STYLE ANTI-PATTERNS SHEET' with version 'v1.1'.
Left column contains the PURPOSE statement, four CORE RULES, the 'PATCH - THE CANON' callout with a canonical Patch thumbs-up figure, and a red 'ANTI-PATTERN - DON'T DO THIS' callout.
Right column contains the 'CHECK BEFORE APPROVAL' checklist and a red 'WHEN IN DOUBT: DON'T' callout.
Central area is split into six numbered panels, each titled with a red category label and populated with rows of thumbnail examples with red X marks and short captions.
Bottom footer reads 'ONE WORLD. ONE STYLE. KEEP IT CLEAR, FRIENDLY, AND ADVENTURES OF PATCH.' with four trait badges: CURIOUS, RELIABLE, ORGANIZED, HELPFUL, and the date 2025-05-13.
patch_canon: Canonical Patch is shown in the top-center 'PATCH - THE CANON' callout as a small humanoid in a teal hooded suit with an off-white face panel, black oval eyes, two dark antennae, and a dark crossbody bag.
The canon callout states that Patch is the visual anchor of the world and any deviation from this design is not approved unless explicitly noted.
content_panels: 1. PATCH STYLE DRIFT - NOT PATCH CANON: Photoreal, Glossy 3D, Plush / Toy, Anime / Chibi, Over-Detailed, Over-Simplified, Gritty / Scary, Wrong Palette, Wrong Eyes, Missing Bag, No Hoodie, Generic Robot.
2. COMPLEXITY & SIMPLIFICATION ERRORS: Too Many Details, Noisy Texture, Too Many Accessories, Unreadable Small, No Visual Hierarchy, Over-Simplified, Proportions Off, Busy Background, Tiny Features.
3. LINE, SHADING & FINISH ERRORS: Sketchy Lines, Inconsistent Lines, Airbrushed, Heavy Realism, Broken Outlines, Wrong Shadows, Muddy Rendering, Harsh Highlights.

4. FAMILY STYLE DRIFT: Humans - Too Realistic, Anime Style; Other Agents - Too Close to Patch, Patched-Up Robot; Mixed Styles in One Scene - Style Mismatch; Props & Environments - Too Realistic, Too Gritty.
5. MOOD, PALETTE & TONE DRIFT: Too Dark, Over-Saturated, Muddy / Desaturated, Harsh Contrast, Hostile Tone, Violent / Creepy, Palette Mismatch.
6. ACCIDENTAL STYLE SMUGGLING / RED FLAGS: Stock Icon Look, Clip Art Feel, Real Logos / Brands, Text Overload, Meme Style, Out-of-World, Weapons / Gear, Politics / Symbols, Horror Imagery.
check_before_approval: Is the character clearly Patch or a non-Patch agent?
Does it match Patch canon exactly when it should?
Is the style clean, friendly, and easy to read?
Are outlines thick, smooth, and consistent?
Is shading soft and simple with clear light direction?
Is the palette on-brand and harmonious?
Is the composition clear with a strong hierarchy?
Are props and environments consistent with the world?
Does the tone feel positive, curious, and helpful?
Would this still look great at small sizes?

positive_constraints: Treat the sheet as a reference of forbidden style variants, not as a positive example to reproduce.
Use the canonical Patch baseline as the only acceptable design source: teal hood, off-white face, black oval eyes, antennae, and correct crossbody bag.
Keep all assets clean, friendly, and easy to read, and maintain a coherent family style across characters, props, and environments.
Protect Patch canon and do not deviate from the approved design unless explicitly noted.
Use the pre-approval checklist to gate new assets before acceptance.
Preserve the clearly labelled anti-pattern categories when matching generated drift to the reference.
negative_constraints: Do not reproduce any of the anti-pattern designs shown in this sheet.
Do not drift toward photorealism, glossy 3D, plush/toy, anime/chibi, over-detailed, over-simplified, or gritty/scary render styles.
Do not over-detail with greeble, tiny text, excess accessories, visual clutter, or over-complicated mechanisms.
Do not produce sketchy or inconsistent lines, muddy or harsh shading, or broken outlines.
Do not make humans too realistic or anime, other agents too close to Patch, or mix unrelated styles in one scene.
Do not use oversaturated neon, muddy desaturated colors, harsh contrast, hostile/violent/creepy moods, or off-brand palettes.
Do not smuggle stock icons, clip-art, real logos, text overload, meme styles, out-of-world symbols, weapons, political symbols, or horror imagery into Adventures of Patch assets.
